implementation: General closed String iteration -> actual selected Map entry -> TextJoin proof; complete CFG and sole-use/immutable-capture checks reject extra operations, filters, consumers or loops. No benchmark/source/name/hash specialization.

For ASCII without CRLF, empty separator and matching single-byte map entries, bind the real source and Map owners, construct a lookup table from actual dictionary entries, reserve output/scratch and finite whole-loop work, then execute an emitted callback-free native byte loop.

Unsupported representations use the ordinary canonical CFG. Empty input preserves lazy map access. Missing keys invoke the original selected access at the first missing position, retain its error origin and discard the private partial output.
Canonical TextJoin shape and result publication remain. Genuine frozen source generation and both owner roots stay pinned through native writes. The same cumulative budgets and atomic output apply.
ONE host round still owns authorize/capture, compiled computation, staging and commit. Native regions are not additional security rounds.
